facts.fact: Neela warmed-water care: Devan warms the cloth water because she once told him in the dark that cold water on open skin made her teeth hurt.
The grey mare favours her off hind; Neela knows her by the sound on the wood road.
Neela erred by leaving the east grove pair standing through the dawn change after a day and a night awake; the second arrow came at that change.
Neela decodes the masters' lines of the roll leaf at the master's desk, letter by letter against the key grid, after matching its torn edge to her desk slip.

The two members'-cipher lines on the roll leaf read 'Intake' and 'Sold at six years'; the two masters'-cipher lines give 'Indu, of Nellimala, coast side of the Monkey Pass' and 'Village burned the second harvest'.
Chathu offered a twelfth tin of sweets in the kennels, which Neela refused (F234); this is the thirteenth tin counting that one.
